The institutional investor held 1.01M shares of the public utilities company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $16.52M, up from 548,488 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bruni J V & Company who had been investing in Centurylink Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $19.43 billion market cap company.
